Steps: Rebalance with a 10-point band then a 9.99-point band

Title: FINDING - zero variance is unreachable so the band is the real criterion
Steps: Rebalance and inspect maximum residual variance
Expected Result: Greater than zero but no more than 0.5 points. Hitting 20.00% exactly needs 66.6667 shares, so an acceptance test written as equality would fail a correct implementation

Title: FINDING - decimal arithmetic beats binary floating point

Steps: Rebalance
Expected Result: BUY exactly 100,000 AAA. In a double 7000/0.07 evaluates to 99999.99999999999 and truncating loses a share. The test also pins the wrong binary answer so it fails if anyone reverts to double
